stages.scope: Our first building! Testing out WorldEdit on the Wizard's Tower near Draynor. Trialling a landscaping - foundation planning - walls and exterior - roof exterior - decorating exterior - designing interior - designing underground - placing lighting - finishing homely touches. Includes the connecting bridge with the STASH
stages.notes:
28/04 - Check out the pretty pictures! Landscaping, foundations, walls, exterior, roof and environment completed. Cycled through a couple of techniques and building materials for this. We now have some decent stencils (trees, walls, bricks, roads) we can copy to new buildings.

01/05 - Completed floors 1-3 interiors, lower ground in progress - choosing between a big catalogue of potential furnishings for future houses

04/05 - And we've finished our first proper feature! All floors are completed and decorated, including the minor island and faerie ring to the north.

Next stop - Draynor Village.

Quest complete!

stages.scope: Test out and agree palette for housing and landmarks across Misthalin.
stages.notes:
We've taken some time to familiarise ourselves with good palettes. Some things we've taken forward:

- Granite, limestone and gradienting them for exterior builds
- Mixing materials with connected textures for pathways.
- We've identified a bunch of cool interior objects - e.g. piles of books/rocks - and supporting beams.

We will figure this out as we go along, as each area will have its own needs. As far as we are concerned...

Quest complete!

stages.scope: Figure out exactly what we need to build this well. Adding WorldEdit + supporting packs (CUI).
stages.notes:
25/04: Identified WorldEdit mod builds compatible with conquest reforged and trialled in sandbox by building a wizard’s tower POC.

27/04: Investigated Ardacraft's modpacks - some good content including Conquest:Architects and Conquest:Hearthfire (as well as minor packs). We decided not to include Create at this stage. We will use native tree functionality. 

04/05: Agreed on starting Modlist
- Conquest Architects
- Conquest Hearthfire
- Believe Mod
- Worldedit
- Worldedit CUI
- FTB Ultimine
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's Worldmap

Quest Complete!

tours.summary: From the market square to the rooms behind familiar doors, then below the streets.

stops.note: Begin in Draynor market square. The exterior stage includes the bank, houses, market and nearby farms.
Step inside Draynor bank. Its interior was one of the first rooms completed in the village.
Look inside the Wise Old Man’s house. The original build notes record the bank and this house together.
Visit Aggie the Witch’s house, another of the village interiors recorded in our build notes.
Finish below the village in Ruantun’s room, part of the Draynor sewers build.

settings.introduction: Rebuilding RuneScape’s Gielinor in Minecraft with Conquest Reforged.
settings.aboutCopy: We’re Marc and David. We grew up playing RuneScape and Minecraft, and decided to bring the two together. We’re rebuilding Gielinor using Conquest Reforged, starting with the Wizard’s Tower, Draynor and Lumbridge.
settings.creditsCopy:
Gielinor and RuneScape belong to Jagex. Minecraft belongs to Mojang and Microsoft. This is an independent fan project, not an official product or an endorsed partnership.

Builds by Marc and David, using Conquest Reforged, WorldEdit and supporting mods. Terrain foundations by Mefisto148, whose map the original build notes credit on CurseForge. Historical references and image captions are retained in the original build logs.

Literata and Source Sans 3 are distributed under the SIL Open Font License. Legacy RuneScape fonts are credited in the retained project archive.
settings.privacyCopy: You can browse without a site account. Saved places and unfinished author drafts stay in this browser and can be cleared. Hosting processes requests to serve the website. External Instagram, Substack and fundraiser links have their own privacy policies. We do not run advertising or behavioural analytics here.

faq.question: Can I visit or download the world?

faq.question: How is the world made?
faq.answer: Minecraft, Conquest Reforged and WorldEdit, on Mefisto148’s Gielinor map.
